# AnimeSenpai
> AnimeSenpai is an anime discovery, tracking, and recommendation platform powered by the live AniList GraphQL network.

## Overview
AnimeSenpai provides a full-featured anime database interface. Users can explore trending anime, search titles across genres, view broadcast countdowns, trailers, studios, and manage personalized watchlists.

## Key Endpoints & Capabilities
- [Home](https://animesenpai.online/#/): Hero spotlight, trending anime, seasonal releases, and genre explorer.
- [Discover](https://animesenpai.online/#/discover): Catalog search with filtering by popularity, score, season, year, format, and genres.
- [Watchlist](https://animesenpai.online/#/watchlist): Personal tracking system (Watching, Planning, Completed, Paused, Dropped).
- [Authentication](https://animesenpai.online/#/login): User profiles and cloud synchronization.

## Agentic Resources & Tools
- [AI Catalog](https://animesenpai.online/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Structured agent discovery catalog
- [ARD Manifest](https://animesenpai.online/.well-known/ard.json): Agentic Resource Discovery v0.91 manifest
- WebMCP: Client tool `searchAnime` exposed via `navigator.modelContext`
